reviews.title: Tech support
reviews.text:
I’ve really enjoyed Peloton’s programs, classes, and instructors. Unfortunately, the connectivity issues have been incredibly frustrating. None of the videos will play directly on my bike, so I’m forced to use my TV, tablet, or phone instead.

I’ve experienced issues with the bike since I purchased it. While Peloton was initially helpful, every attempt to resolve a problem has been extremely time-consuming. Now, despite the fact that I cannot watch any videos on the bike itself, technical support insists there is nothing wrong and therefore nothing they can do.

It’s disappointing because I genuinely love the Peloton experience, but the ongoing technical problems and lack of a meaningful resolution have made it difficult to enjoy a product I invested so much in. I expect the bike to function as advertised, especially when the classes and programming are the primary reasons for purchasing it.

reviews.title: Crashing
reviews.text: The app crashes every time I open it now.

reviews.title: Why I’ll probably leave peloton
reviews.text: I work out with the app all the time and was closing into a 700 day streak. Today I didn’t log my gym session and that caused me to lose my streak. This made me realize that this app only cares about usage; not your fitness journey.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: No ability to change profiles and I can’t even figure out how to log out. I’ve looked everywhere.

reviews.title: Unable to share stories on Ig
reviews.text: The best part was showing my stats to IG stories when I finished my workout now it’s changed and can’t even see calories burned. Unacceptable

reviews.title: Needs to fix the latest update
reviews.text: I used to love peloton 5/5 but after the recent update they changed the language settings so even if you have another language that isn’t English as your preferred language and the language you want to see classes in, it will include every English video that has different subtitles. Most people want to listen to the audio in the language they choose and not English with subtitles and you should be able to filter better because the English videos flood out everything else and you have to scroll forever to find the classes in the actual language you want to take classes in.

reviews.title: Apple Health Bug
reviews.text: Great app usually but recent issue with syncing to Apple health reduce its usefulness. Needs a fix ASAP!

reviews.title: Login doesn't work
reviews.text: I don't have a lot of time to exercise as it is, I shouldn't need to spend 10-15 minutes trying to log into the bike because the QR code takes me to the app from the camera but doesn't actually log me in. There's no obvious place within the app to scan the code. I don't need a quasi social media app throwing irrelevant junk at me. Just basic core functionality easy to find and use.

reviews.title: Still great for workouts but not passing health data
reviews.text: Latest update for new iOS broke Apple Health sync for me. App writes workout time/calories but fails to send cycling distance, tread distance, or elevation into HealthKit.

reviews.title: Current calendar month gone
reviews.text:
In a recent app update, the current calendar month workout totals have been eliminated. Now it’s either a running 30-day total or the last full calendar month. Current 
Month totals was a critical view for me and needs to be restored ASAP.

reviews.title: Gym Routins
reviews.text: Gym routines would be better if they ran automatically, progressing through the set without needed to manually go into each set. Audio descriptions for each movement and music would also be good additions

reviews.title: NOT Still Supporting Apple Watch Series 3
reviews.text:
UPDATED: Two weeks later and Series 3 support is gone, and so is the app on my watch. Tell Apple where to shove it!

Thank you for continuing to support Series 3s with the latest update. It has been very disappointing to lose other paid apps because their latest updates require Watch IOS 9.0. Peloton rocks - fight the power!

reviews.title: Limit Not Allowing Two Bikes loses our subscription
reviews.text: We’ve used Peloton for 6 years now and love the workouts and devices. I’m in tech and appreciate their usability and attention to detail. However we bought a second bike and learned that two devices of the same kind are not allowed on the same account, even if they are within the 5 device limit. To support a second bike we would need an entire second subscription which is ridiculous. We also have a Peloton rower so If we were to do that we would have to log in and out to switch on the rower constantly. It is such an inconvenience and limits us being able to workout together. iFit and Nordictrack do not impose a limit like this, they are purely based on members on the account so we may be selling off our equipment to build the gym how we want on a system that supports it. Unfortunate but I won’t let an arbitrary rule limit our fitness goals.

reviews.title: Dropped watch series 3 support
reviews.text: Literally all it is for is heart rate. Why drop support for something that has worked fine for years?

reviews.title: What is wrong with you Peloton?
reviews.text:
Why isn’t CYCLING the very 1st of everything in your app?  Why do I have to scroll?  What exercises or equipment made your popular, Pilates????

Why do you let people continue to cheat?  Output by a lot of people are unreal.  They are not Olympians or college or pro athletes but you allow them unreal outputs and especially older people high output are unreal. There is no way anyone 60 or above can beat someone younger unless they are a superior athlete. Guess what if they really were we would know their names and there would not be that many of them. 

#STOPallCHEATERS#….really just do it.  I am at the point of moving away from Peloton if I do not see changes. I have been a member since 2021 after the purchase of my peloton bike, but I am ready to stop paying a monthly fee….are you ready to stop receiving my money???????

reviews.title: Step Backwards
reviews.text: The new app layout is cumbersome and way to confusing. They have removed so many awesome metrics. Even the basic metric tracking total workouts for each activity have been removed. Please give us option to toggle back to old version.

reviews.title: Changes to app
reviews.text: The new changes to the app involve limiting classes .  You can no longer access your bookmarked classes or history classes without upgrading your membership.  It no seems like a community.  I have been with Peloton for many years.  I no longer feel like I can recommend this app to my friends or colleagues.  I am very sad and disappointed!!

reviews.title: App is good just don’t use another app
reviews.text: App is good until an activity tells you a workout is starting. In that case don’t expect much volume in audible, podcast, or a music app. It takes over your sound levels because it thinks it’s more important. Support was worthless. Have to close the app to get your sound back.

reviews.title: Epic Failure
reviews.text: I made the mistake of purchasing a Peloton Bike after having the app for other workouts for over a year.  I paid the full year subscription ($159, up from the $99 last year).  I “upgraded” to the all access membership two months after paying for the full year.  After calling support, Melanie informed me that there is no prorated rate and I have to call Apple Pay for a refund because the different Peloton memberships do not communicate with each other (but my membership information is still the same and the workout history seamlessly transferred). Do yourself a favor and do not change membership status until your subscription is ready to be renewed. If you do have to call the customer service number be prepared to be placed on numerous holds without any real assistance or answers to your questions.

reviews.title: Will blast your phone with popups
reviews.text: One of the more recent changes has started sending popups to my phone telling me about people I’m connected with. “High five UserX now! They’re on a streak!” I don’t really care but peloton doesn’t let me turn them off. I’m either all in on notifications or off. I like that I get push notifications on my trend or status of needing to work out. But no, I can’t disable the popups that I don’t care about. I have disabled them completely now which is unfortunate. If developers actually read this, some of us care about the “noise” on our devices and work to manage what needs to be seen vs what doesn’t.

reviews.title: Unresolved tech issue
reviews.text: I have paid a ridiculous amount of money for a Peloton subscription so it is disheartening that they cannot seem to make their system work. I receive a pop-up ad when I start the program, which blocks any further activity. I’ve called Peloton customer support and tech-support in the past but the error has not been resolved.

reviews.title: Why you’re losing subscribers.
reviews.text: There’s so much unnecessary friction within the app. Things that should be simple like linking my Apple Music account to Peloton are unnecessarily complicated.  A number of times I’ve gone into the Peloton app and started a workout and the handshake doesn’t happen properly so I’m 5 or 10 minutes in and wondering why my heart rate isn’t showing come to find out the app just either connects or it fails and you’re never notified - who thought of that? If someone went out of the way to launch the Peloton app to sync their workout, why not call out that the sync failed. What’s even more wild is to have a CEO FROM APPLE and to have so much trouble syncing with the most popular wearable device on the planet.

reviews.title: Great in theory
reviews.text:
I love Peloton. Unfortunately, the app seems determined to make me question that relationship.

The app crashes on launch more often than it should, and its Apple Health integrations are frustratingly inconsistent—particularly when you’re relying on accurate workout data to track fitness goals. It’s remarkable that an otherwise excellent fitness ecosystem can be undermined by something as fundamental as reliably recording the workout you just completed.

And when you reach out to Peloton Support for help? Prepare for a journey into the administrative equivalent of a black hole. After multiple troubleshooting steps, the problem remains unresolved, and the experience has generated considerably more frustration than resolution.

I’m a genuine Peloton fan, which is what makes this so disappointing. The hardware and workouts are great. The app and support experience, unfortunately, feel like they were assigned to a completely different company.

reviews.title: What a Joke!
reviews.text: The Disney+ app on the bike is hilariously awful. Like, why would you possibly allow this? Or advertise it?

reviews.title: Upgrades messed up Apple Watch
reviews.text: Your recent upgrade messed with my series 3 Apple Watch and now I cannot connect it with the Peloton app.  So I can’t track my workouts, heart rate, etc.  it’s frustrating!

reviews.title: Keep losing signal during outdoor activities
reviews.text: I’ve deleted and reinstalled and made sure I have the latest update, but my app continues to lose signal in the middle of an outdoor activity, not giving me accurate feedback on the workout.

reviews.title: Non existent support services
reviews.text:
I have been a Peloton member for years and have an active All-Access Membership, but this experience has me seriously reconsidering whether I want to continue paying for it.

I had an issue with Breathwrk, which is supposed to be included with my Peloton membership. The app crashed after a session, logged me out, and then suddenly claimed that I didn’t have a membership and tried to get me to pay for one. I contacted Peloton by email, and received an automated response telling me that the best way to get help was through live chat or by phone.

So I clicked the “Live Chat” link they provided.

It sent me straight to an AI chatbot.

There is apparently no longer a way to simply send a message to an actual human at Peloton. I’m expected to either spend who-knows-how-long sitting on the phone or fight my way through an AI bot that can’t actually resolve the problem.

This is an absolutely ridiculous customer service experience for someone who has been paying for a Peloton membership for YEARS.

I don’t expect every app to work perfectly. Things glitch. That’s life. What matters is whether a company makes it possible for paying customers to get help when something goes wrong. Peloton currently makes that unnecessarily difficult.

Ironically, I was trying to use Breathwrk to relax and manage stress. Instead, I ended up spending my time trying to figure out how to talk to a human being at the company I’m paying.

Do better, Peloton. Your longtime members deserve better customer sup

reviews.title: Filters gone. Too hard to search for classes
reviews.text: They removed the filters to refine searches by length of time, instructor, even language. Tired of scrolling through all the German classes (tons!!!) to get a workout I’ll understand. Feel like the app update created an algorithm and now I’m stuck and a bit bored with what the app “shows” me. It’s too hard to mix things up now

reviews.title: $99 fee to activate a used bike
reviews.text: While the quality of the app is great, they charge you $99 to activate a bike if you have bought it second hand or gifted it. This just seems unreasonable to me and a way to grab more money.

reviews.title: What a joke
reviews.text: You need to pay 29/mo just to be able to watch netflix/disney+ on top of those subscriptions. It costs them nothing to be able to allow us to access them in just ride. I dont care about leader boards. I dont care about the lessons. I just want to be anle to watch netflix while i ride on my peloton. I brought the bike during covid and have since stopped using it and wanted to get back in to it.

reviews.title: The Worst
reviews.text: Peloton lost all of my account information. Charged me to create another account. Wouldn’t let me use my old information as they said it was in use but claimed they couldn’t find my old account. Tech support is from India and could barely understand anything. Tech support basically gave up and said they couldn’t find my precious account that Peloton charged two days before the account was lost. 5 years of workout history gone because Peloton’s tech is garbage.

reviews.title: Ehhh
reviews.text: I star cuz its hard and im weak

reviews.title: Distance off
reviews.text: This rating is for the distance tracker. I thought I was going crazy when I would use the peloton app to track my running distance. This thing is way off. I ran the same route with onyx backcountry and apple and peleton. Peloton was off by more than .6 of a mile. This is a pretty large error by the app. Any suggestions?

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text:
Terrible plan subs always pushing to add more subs
Doesn’t connect via Bluetooth, heart rate also doesn’t connect w Apple Watch. Terrible.

reviews.title: Latest version breaks Garmin integration
reviews.text: Only first ride of the day will sync to Garmin. Definitely a regression.

reviews.title: No pace for outdoor workouts on watch
reviews.text: I had to come on here to leave a negative review- to maybe get someone’s attention. The fact that you pace is not available on your watch during an outdoor walk/run/cycle is insane. Need an update to correct this ASAP

reviews.title: Forced all access subscription
reviews.text: All I have is the peloton bike and that’s all I want to use. Why am I forced to pay $50 a month for an all access that I’m not going to use? I literally just want to use the programs on the screen that came with the bike.

reviews.title: Programs don’t progress
reviews.text: I was trying to do the beginner strength program which I was enjoying. However, it does not allow you to progress to the next class. It does not let you skip classes although other programs do this one just seems to have a bug. It’s very annoying and disappointing that you’re paying for workouts and you can’t even use them. Please fix this!!!

reviews.title: Recent Update
reviews.text: Bike and Peloton Guide now does not sync with Apple Watch since update.

reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text: Outdoor runs regularly stop mid run. Whether from phantom input or crash it’s super annoying. Further made worse by missing a key feature to resume a run or even fast forward to where you left off. Rudimentary features simply missing.

reviews.title: Heart Rate Monitor Never Connects
reviews.text: The fatal flaw of this app is everytime you get the Apple Watch heart rate monitor to actually work an update comes out that requires hard resets on every device.  This last one was the final straw for me.

reviews.title: Apple Watch Feature Still Garbage
reviews.text: I have no idea why Peloton allows its app developers to create such a pathetic Apple Watch interface, the heart rate, strive score and class connectors thru Apple Watch is inconsistent on its best day and non existent on most days. Do Better

reviews.title: Removing classes and re-uploading with terrible music
reviews.text: Did Peloton think people wouldn’t notice that they started putting classes behind a paywall? Then they thought they could re-upload some of them with trash playlists? Really? I found out they signed some type of new music licensing agreement. No communication to members. This is a terrible customer experience and the customer service I attempted to use on the website was terrible. I would expect more from a company so large. It’s also frustrating because I do not have Peloton equipment - so to upgrade the app feels like a large ask just to get audio classes back. Ridiculous. Very disappointed in this move and considering cancelling my membership altogether

reviews.title: Watch not reading heart rate
reviews.text: My Apple Watch Ultra connects to the session but won’t take my hearts rate. Other apps like Strava and native activity tracker is able to access heart rate.

reviews.title: Awful communication!!!
reviews.text: once you pay, good luck!! You will not be dealing with anybody that knows how to communicate and that’s if you get a human being on the phone

reviews.title: Worst customer support experience ever
reviews.text: Genuinely the worst customer support experience I have ever had. Customer service and the company will try to scam you out of your money. I will be deleting my account and telling everyone I know to not use peloton. I am incredibly disappointed with this company and experience. The actions of this company do not align with what it claims to be its mission and feels like I have been lied to, deceived and scammed.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: The membership structure is intentionally misleading. Outrageous monthly pricing to use with the bike.

reviews.title: Bad software
reviews.text:
I generally like the idea and exercises of Peloton. But software and support are done on the cheap and not functioning
1 SEARCH is rubbish - it finds you everything despite being asked to find exact things
2 No one knows where the bookmarked exercises are stored - it could not be found anywhere - not in profile not at Home Screen and there is no special button.
3 Support does not have idea how to find it either. I asked and the poor chap just mumbled something for 30 minutes. 
I’m paying £45 monthly and would like you to do your bloody job for the money I and thousands of other users pay.

reviews.title: No accessbility sync
reviews.text: The app does all you would expect, nothing extra but crucially doesn’t support larger text and accessibility options in iPhone settings. How very inclusive of you Peloton. Not.

reviews.title: Love the peloton platform but integration to Apple Watches is appalling
reviews.text: Can’t connect, connect but can’t read heart rate, constantly trying to connect when I’m not taking a class, failing to disconnect. It’s almost like peloton are trying to sabotage apple

reviews.title: New app is a pain
reviews.text: Overly complicated. Not responsive. Tricky to navigate. Once in the part of the app desired works well. Seems to be overly focused on directing user to classes.
